title: Developing nuanced opinions
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply developing nuanced opinions in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 回答抽象口语问题时给出有层次的观点，不背诵固定立场。
grammar: I tend to、for the most part、it depends on 精确表达倾向与条件。先直接回答，再给理由和一个限定；避免让 depends 成为不作答的借口。
common_mistake: 为了显得高级而堆叠多个 hedge 会让立场听不清。

examples.text: I generally prefer studying in a library because the setting helps me separate work from home.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: That said, the best place depends on the task.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: If I need to practise a presentation aloud, a quiet library desk is not suitable.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: At home I can record a rehearsal without disturbing other readers.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

reading: I generally prefer studying in a library because the setting helps me separate work from home. That said, the best place depends on the task. If I need to practise a presentation aloud, a quiet library desk is not suitable. At home I can record a rehearsal without disturbing other readers. So I would not describe one place as better for every learner or every activity. My preference reflects the kind of concentration I usually need, rather than a universal rule about effective study.

pronunciation: sentence stress; connected speech; intelligibility without a total score。先按意群朗读，再用选词面板练习；浏览器转写不能证明音素正确。
production: Produce an original spoken explanation plus a written reflection demonstrating developing nuanced opinions
self_review: 核对任务是否回答完整、信息是否有原文证据、目标结构是否准确。记录一次修改及理由；开放题允许不同的有据答案，不计算官方等级分数。
